description: Annual global conventional CDR from afforestation, reforestation and forest management
transformation_summary: Exact row filter; columns selected and renamed; no interpolation
intended_use: Primary historical input for the model's conventional-removal component
caution: This is conventional CDR, not the full natural land sink.

description: Annual global novel CDR reported by the source
transformation_summary: Exact row filter; columns selected and renamed; no interpolation
caution: The published aggregate is rounded and should not be expected to equal the sum of unrounded method rows exactly.

description: Global novel CDR separated by removal method
transformation_summary: Exact row filter; no aggregation or interpolation
caution: Method rows do not exist for every method in every year; absent rows are not imputed as zero.

description: Global novel CDR pipeline by method and achieved/additional component
data_type: Historical values through 2025 and pipeline estimates from 2026
transformation_summary: Exact row filter; method suffix parsed into method and component; no interpolation
intended_use: Near-term novel-CDR model calibration and pipeline scenario
caution: Values for 2026-2030 are project-pipeline estimates, not observed removals.

description: Total global novel CDR in the project-pipeline series
data_type: Historical values through 2025 and pipeline estimates from 2026
transformation_summary: Sum of all source rows within each year; no interpolation
intended_use: Direct input for the supplied draft's near-term novel-CDR equation
caution: Do not treat the 2026-2030 values as observations.

description: Conventional and novel CDR placed on one annual grid
transformation_summary: Outer merge on annual grid; total calculated only when both components are reported; no imputation
caution: Blank cells are outside the source coverage and are deliberately not filled.

description: Global total, conventional and novel CDR across models and policy scenarios
transformation_summary: Exact row filter; numeric years retained; Gt CO2/yr converted to Mt CO2/yr by multiplying by 1000
intended_use: Long-term scenario comparison and sensitivity analysis
caution: These are model scenarios, not observations or forecasts with a single expected path.

description: Global land, ocean and cement-carbonation sinks in original and converted units
transformation_summary: Columns selected; Mt CO2/yr = Gt C/yr x (44/12) x 1000; no interpolation
intended_use: Independent contextual comparison with global sinks
caution: Natural land and ocean sinks are not anthropogenic CDR and must remain separate from SoCDR CDR.

description: World forest-land emissions and removals with original flags
transformation_summary: World emissions/removals rows reshaped from wide to annual table; flags retained; removal-positive Mt CO2/yr = -official kt / 1000
caution: The source uses negative values for removals. The converted columns reverse the sign. Carbon stock change in forests is the balance of Forestland and Net Forest conversion, so the three FAOSTAT series must not be summed. Do not add this dataset to conventional CDR because their accounting boundaries overlap.

description: Common-year reference table for conventional CDR, natural sinks and FAO forest fluxes
transformation_summary: Left joins on an explicit 2005-2024 annual grid; no interpolation and no cross-source summation
caution: Columns use different accounting boundaries. Compare trends only; do not sum them.

description: Auditable source values corresponding to the supplied model draft
transformation_summary: Exact lookup or transparent aggregation from cleaned source rows
caution: The published aggregate, method sum and pipeline total are distinct indicators and should not be mixed without explanation.
